articles.title: WTF is Going On? | The "AI Constitution" & Regulation
articles.summary: SUPPORT OUR WORK: for the campaign, or grab individual items here:
body: The AI companies all gathered together to collectively write a new so-called "AI Constitution" where they police themselves. The accord effectively does nothing, but it does set in place the pieces to enable what should be competitors to collaborate even closer. In addition to a rebranding as "Super Intelligence" with an Executive Order, AI has faced increasing calls for regulation from the public while executives like Jensen Huang of NVIDIA have demanded speeding-up development. Jensen's cousin, Lisa Su of AMD, has partnered with Michael Kratsios of the White House to reduce clean air and clean water regulations that slow data center buildouts. They've already had the same goals, it seems -- but now the companies are formalizing a partnership.
